one_line: Physician-commander of the Rani of Jhansi Regiment of the Indian National Army, leading women through training, medical duty and the Burma retreat in 1943–45.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, medium height, lean but sturdy build suggesting both a doctor’s long hours and military drill fitness.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, intelligent look; medium-brown complexion, straight nose, neat brows, and warm, observant dark eyes; default expression is composed and determined, with a subtle softness when she tends to the wounded.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair parted slightly to the left, pulled back smoothly into a low bun at the nape of the neck; no loose flyaways, held by a simple dark brown cloth band; no cap in most scenes, but she may don a plain khaki field cap during marches.
appearance.costume: A neat INA-style khaki uniform adapted for women: long-sleeved buttoned khaki shirt with two breast pockets and a modest stand collar, sleeves rolled to just below the elbows; khaki cloth belt with a simple metal buckle at the waist; ankle-length straight khaki skirt with a front box pleat for ease of movement; plain dark brown leather lace-up ankle boots with khaki socks just visible; on her left arm a cloth INA tricolour armband (saffron, white, green with a central springing tiger motif suggested but not overly ornate); a simple thin steel wristwatch on her left wrist; minimal jewellery—small plain gold stud earrings and a very thin gold chain tucked inside her shirt; fabric is sturdy cotton drill, clean and well-kept, with only faint creases to show field use.
appearance.signature: A compact, well-used brown leather medical satchel worn crossbody (strap over right shoulder, bag resting at left hip), its flap secured by two buckles, with a stethoscope tucked under the flap so that its dark tubing and silver chest piece are just visible when the bag is slightly open.

ref_desc: Lakshmi Sahgal is a calm, medium-brown–skinned woman in her early 30s with dark eyes and dark hair in a low bun, wearing a neat long-sleeved khaki INA shirt, ankle-length khaki skirt, brown ankle boots, INA tricolour armband, and a brown leather crossbody medical satchel with a visible stethoscope.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Lakshmi Sahgal: a determined, medium-brown–skinned woman in her early 30s with an oval face, thoughtful dark eyes, and dark brown-black hair parted slightly left and pulled back into a smooth low bun at the nape of her neck with a simple dark cloth band; her default expression is composed and serious, with a hint of warmth when she looks toward the viewer. She wears an era-accurate World War II Indian National Army khaki uniform adapted for women: a long-sleeved buttoned khaki shirt with two breast pockets and a modest stand collar, sleeves neatly rolled to just below the elbows, tucked into an ankle-length straight khaki skirt with a front box pleat; a plain khaki cloth belt with a simple metal buckle cinches her waist. On her feet are dark brown leather lace-up ankle boots with khaki socks barely visible at the top. On her left upper arm is a cloth INA tricolour armband in saffron, white and green with a simple springing tiger emblem suggested in the centre without heavy detail. She wears minimal jewellery: tiny gold stud earrings and a very thin gold chain tucked inside her shirt, plus a slim steel wristwatch on her left wrist. Her signature prop is a compact brown leather medical satchel worn crossbody with the strap over her right shoulder and the bag resting at her left hip; the flap is closed with two buckles, and the dark tubing and silver chest piece of a stethoscope are just visible peeking from under the flap as if ready for use. Use a realistic cotton-drill texture for the khaki uniform, keeping it clean but slightly creased from field work, and emphasize a restrained palette of khaki, dark brown, warm medium brown skin tone, and the saffron and forest green of the armband; present her front, side and back to clearly show her consistent face, hair, uniform and medical satchel.
